claim.summary: Conjecture: for the functional pigeonhole system over F_2 (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms, multilinear ring) with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at a proper degree D, K<=D-1, and any set F of monomial errors E with K+deg E<=D, the common kernel {u in V_K: uE in C for E in F} modulo the degree-D closure C equals the common kernel modulo the closure H of the hole and functionality axioms alone, plus C cap V_K. Monomials on one pigeon or one hole lie in H and constrain neither side. Extends conj:functional-kernel-transfer (deg E=1) to monomial errors; via multiplication by x_b, Ann_C(x_a x_b) = mu_b^{-1}(Ann_C^{(2)}(x_a)). Evidence: check:block-pair-kernels.
claim.assessment: Conjecture; evidence check:block-pair-kernels at one size, F_2, K=1, D=3; the sole fresh-context medium reviewer checked its scope and the mu_b reduction.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: A positive excess would be a killer the pigeon axioms add, a joint saving beyond supports; none found.
significance.next_action: Prove it at K=1 by comparing leading forms of a member uE of degree 3.

claim.summary: Exact F_2 computation (block_pairs.py reusing three_quantities.py and tools/pc_closure.py) on the functional pigeonhole system with 6 pigeons and 5 holes at D=3, K=1 (dim V_1=31, C cap V_1 the 6 pigeon axioms): the error sets {x00x11}, {x00x11,x22x33}, {x00x11,x11x22}, {x00x11,x01x10}, {x00x11,x00x22} and {x00x11,x22x33,x34x43} have total excess 0, single excess 0 and joint defect 0, with surviving domain killers modulo C cap V_1 of dimension 16, 8, 11, 15, 11, 4. Controls: the variable set {x00,x11} gives excess 0 as recorded; the linear-axiom positive control gives excess 1. By the S_6 x S_5 symmetry the singleton covers every pair on distinct pigeons and holes.
claim.assessment: Exact computation; the script, masks and controls checked by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer, who recomputed the H-side dimensions by hand; no control runs the degree-2 error path on the C side.

claim.summary: Conjecture: for the functional pigeonhole system over F_2 (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms, multilinear ring) with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at every proper degree D and K<=D-1, the common kernel in V_K of a set of variables modulo the degree-D closure C equals the common kernel modulo the closure H of the monomial axioms alone, plus C cap V_K. Evidence: K=1 at 6x5 (check:functional-factor-kernels) and K=2 at 6x5 and 7x6, all at D=3 (check:functional-kernels-k2), F_2 and m=n+1 only. Variable errors are load-bearing: non-monomial errors are governed by other memberships (check:truncated-kernel-beyond-support).
claim.assessment: Conjecture from finite checks at D=3 on two boards; a proposed route (unverified) is the dual design-extension form through prop:exact-operator-criterion at D<=ceil(n/2), which stops at a top-layer correction.

claim.summary: Exact F2 computation with tools/pc_closure.py on the functional pigeonhole system (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms): refutation degree 3 at 3 and 4 holes and 4 at 5 holes; at 6 pigeons, 5 holes, D=3, K=1 (dim V_1=31, C cap V_1 the 6 pigeon axioms), for factor sets {x00,x10}, {x00,x01}, {x00,x11}, {x00,x11,x22}, {x00,x11,x22,x33} the common kernel of the factor maps has dimension 11, 9, 8, 6, 6 and equals the common kernel in the closure of the monomial axioms alone (dimension 5, 4, 2, 0, 0) plus C cap V_1. A positive control (monomial axioms ab, bz, linear axiom w+a+z, D=2, F={w}) gives 3 against 2, so linear axioms can transport killers and the equality is not generic. At 7 pigeons and 6 holes (proper at D=3, dim V_1=43, C cap V_1 the 7 pigeon axioms) the same sets give 13, 11, 9, 7, 7 against Ann_H 6, 5, 2, 0, 0 plus the relations, again equal.
claim.assessment: Finite check by exact elimination (functional_factor_kernels.py, functional_factor_kernels.json, the first run's output and the timeout); numbers checked by the reviewer, who supplied the positive control.
